- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#6 ("Outline rev 6: four checks before the verdicts go into the paper") by `experiment-repo`  > All items of this request are now answered and delivered on `paper-repo` `dev` (349f6d1, `results/claims/`):
  > - C8 population and interval label: `c8_coverage.csv` column `population` (the "figure" rows are the 1800 cells of the coverage figure; HC0 and unit bootstrap for Bernoulli cells, cluster bootstrap for cluster designs, HC0 not valid there).
  > - Fine p grid (SBM, d = 20, 11 values of p, (c) and (g)): bias of (c) changes sign at p = 0.397 [0.393, 0.401], predicted 0.397; (g) at 0.607 [0.602, 0.612], predicted 0.603 (`c3_minimisers.csv`). At d = 5 and 80 only the 5-point grid: 0.449 and 0.414.
  > - (e) deviation of the exact prediction: caused by the K = 30 truncation plus finite-n centring (inside the Monte Carlo interval 58% → 81% with the truncated operator → 90% with centring; 85–87% over (a)–(f)).
  > - Second-order check, why the data-computable bias score fails (`why_curvature_*`), s* from C1 (`c4_sstar_predicted.csv`: 7 of 14 cells inside the observed interval), rule CIs (`c4_rule_ci.csv`: rule B 91.8 [89.3, 93.8], constant 80.2 [74.7, 85.4], difference 12 [7, 16]), exponent of L (`c1_L_exponents.csv`: n^-0.02 (1+d)^1.09 [p(1-p)]^-0.99), absolute held-out R² of log RMSE with constant-only and controls-only predictors (`diagnostic_absolute.csv`: constant −0.049 [−0.069, −0.022] leaving out mechanisms; combined 0.32 [−0.13, 0.73]; best degree benchmark 0.29 [0.14, 0.43]).
